scripts.motor: node motor-fotos.js && node video-fotos.js && node motor-sintetico.js 30 0.08 30 5000 && node video-sintetico.js 12
scripts.camera-falsa: mkdir -p saida && ffmpeg -loglevel error -y -loop 1 -i fotos/193478.jpg -t 4 -r 5 -vf "scale=720:1280:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=720:1280:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2" -pix_fmt yuv420p saida/cam.y4m
scripts.navegador: node servidor.js & SRV=$!; sleep 1; node navegador.js; R=$?; kill $SRV; exit $R
scripts.tudo: npm run motor && npm run camera-falsa && npm run navegador
